requirements.text: New features must be compliant with regulatory requirements to avoid risks.
The app should provide real-time notifications for transactions.
Customers should be able to freeze or unfreeze their cards directly in the app.
The app should offer spending breakdowns to help customers manage their finances.
Strong Customer Authentication must be implemented for payment transactions.
Customer financial data must remain within the bounds of GDPR.
Compliance with consumer protection regulations is crucial for any lending features.
New features must integrate with existing systems.
